conventions.title: Timestamps
conventions.text: Every series is keyed on `ts_utc` = interval START in UTC. `ts_local` is the same instant in America/New_York for display. Daily rollups use local calendar days (23/25 hours on DST days).

conventions.title: Interval-ending stamps
conventions.text: NYISO stamps real-time LBMP (realtime_*) and fuel mix at interval END; the parser shifts them to start (stamp − 5 min in the curated tables). Load, interface flows, constraints, DA and integrated hourly files are stamped at interval START.

conventions.title: Fall-back DST day
conventions.text: Files with a Time Zone column (EDT/EST) are localized from it. Otherwise, per entity in file order, every row after local time steps backward (or repeats) is EST. 'First occurrence = EDT' is wrong: off-grid stamps in the EST hour (e.g. 01:02:48 on 2021-11-07) occur once. Regression test: tests/test_parse.py::test_offgrid_stamps_in_repeated_hour_are_est.

conventions.title: Irregular RTD intervals and time weighting
conventions.text: ~4% of real-time intervals are not 5 minutes (delayed RTD runs publish stamps like 02:59:55). Curated tables keep stamps as published. Derived tables rebuild each interval's true [start, end) from the neighbouring stamp (gaps > 15 min are treated as missing data with a nominal 5-min interval) and time-weight onto 5-min/hourly buckets (store/timeweight.py). Verified: reproduces NYISO's integrated hourly RT LBMP to the cent in every hour 2021–2024. Averages over derived tables should weight by covered_s.

conventions.title: Price components
conventions.text: LBMP = energy + mlc − mcc (verified: energy is identical across all zones in an interval). A negative mcc means congestion raises the local price.

conventions.title: Accepted data flags
conventions.text: lbmp_zone_hourly.rt_flag marks hours where NYISO's integrated RT differs from its own 5-min data (2025-05-27 19:00–21:00: NYISO 5-min intervals missing; the latest hour at download time). Values are kept as published.

conventions.title: Known NYISO archive gaps
conventions.text: rt_lbmp_node: 2026-08-01..26 missing (map falls back to hourly). rt_lbmp_zone_hourly: 2026-07-01..20 missing (filled, rt_source='derived_twa'). btm_solar: ~20 whole days missing. Full per-day detail: data/coverage.parquet.

conventions.title: Dashboard KPI definitions
conventions.text: Price = simple average of the 11 internal zones' RT LBMP (not load-weighted; GridStatus uses a slightly different figure). Net load = load − wind. Main source = largest fuel at the selected interval.

conventions.title: Zone boundaries
conventions.text: No openly licensed NYISO zone boundary file exists (NYPA's ArcGIS layer forbids redistribution). zones.geojson assigns Census counties to zones by majority vote of generator nodes, with overrides (Putnam→HUD VL, Livingston→GENESE, Westchester split at 41.13°N into MILLWD/DUNWOD). Approximate; drop an official file at data/ref/zones_override.geojson to replace it.

conventions.title: Node mapping
conventions.text: Only generator nodes have coordinates. 561 of 758 priced nodes are mapped; the rest lack coordinates or are retired units absent from the current generator.csv.

conventions.title: As-of availability
conventions.text: Forecast issue time for D+1 = 05:00 ET on D−1 (NYISO DAM bid deadline, MST 4.2; results post by 11:00). ISOLF file dated F is posted ~07:05–08:20 ET on F (MIS P-7 index), so it is usable from 08:30 ET on F: a 05:00 D−1 issue may only use the ISOLF file of D−2. DA prices for D−1 are known from 11:00 on D−2. RT data is known up to its interval end. Henry Hub for trade date T: 00:00 ET on T+1. Weather obs: hour + 30 min. Weather forecasts: see weather_fcst.available_utc. Outage schedules: first_seen_utc. External tables carry available_utc explicitly.

conventions.title: Licensing
conventions.text: NYISO MIS, NOAA and EIA data are public. weather_fcst comes from Open-Meteo's free, non-commercial API and is for research/backtesting only; replace it with a licensed forecast source before any live trading use.

conventions.title: Units
conventions.text: Prices $/MWh; power MW (MIS labels some flow/limit columns 'MWH' — they are interval rates in MW); shares are fractions 0–1.

files.data/raw/<dataset>/<YYYYMM>.zip: Immutable cache of NYISO MIS monthly archives (one CSV per day). Never edited; delete a file to force re-download.
files.data/raw/<dataset>/daily/<YYYYMMDD>.csv: Daily-file fallback for days missing from a monthly archive.
files.data/curated/<dataset>/year=YYYY/month=M: Parsed, typed, deduplicated data (zstd). One file per source month; the curated views read these. Rebuild with `nyiso backfill --rebuild`.
files.data/nyiso.duckdb: Views over curated Parquet + derived tables. Disposable; `nyiso build` recreates it.
files.data/ref/loads.parquet: Load points: name, ptid, subzone, zone (no coordinates are published).
files.data/ref/zones.geojson: APPROXIMATE zone polygons (county-based; see conventions: zone boundaries).
files.data/ref/reference_report.json: Counts of mapped/unmapped nodes from `nyiso reference`.
files.data/coverage.parquet: Per dataset per local day: intervals present vs expected, coverage fraction (`nyiso validate`).

sched_outages.description: Scheduled transmission outages as published over time (point-in-time).
sched_outages.source: MIS schedlineoutages/*SCLineOutages.csv (schedule re-published every 5 min; compacted)
notes: To get the schedule known at time t: first_seen_utc <= t <= last_seen_utc. Runs are split at month boundaries and at publishing gaps > 15 min.
Ambiguous fall-back local times in sched_out/in are read as EDT (no marker published).

columns.equipment: Transmission equipment name as published (line, transformer, breaker).
columns.sched_out_utc: Scheduled outage start (published local time -> UTC).
columns.sched_in_utc: Scheduled return to service. For outages in progress NYISO rolls this forward hourly, so one outage appears as several records.
columns.first_seen_utc: First snapshot in which this exact record appeared (start of a validity run). [UTC timestamp]
columns.last_seen_utc: Last snapshot in which this exact record appeared (end of a validity run). The record was part of the published schedule for all t in [first_seen_utc, last_seen_utc]. [UTC timestamp]
columns.snapshots: Number of snapshots in the validity run.

columns.last_seen_utc: Last snapshot in which this exact record appeared (end of a validity run). The record was part of the published schedule for all t in [first_seen_utc, last_seen_utc]. [UTC timestamp]
columns.snapshots: Number of snapshots in the validity run.

da_sched_outages.description: Transmission outages scheduled in each day's DAM (one list per market day).
notes: Lists every outage whose window overlaps the market day; one equipment can have several windows.

As-of rule: the list for day D is posted ~09:40 ET on D-1 (archive file times confirm the as-posted version is kept), i.e. after the 05:00 ET D-1 forecast issue. Forecasts for D may use the list for D-1 and earlier.
Ambiguous fall-back local times in sched_out/in are read as EDT (no marker published).

columns.ts_utc: Start of the market day the list applies to (00:00 ET, in UTC).
columns.equipment: Transmission equipment name as published (line, transformer, breaker).
columns.sched_out_utc: Scheduled outage start (published local time -> UTC).
columns.sched_in_utc: Scheduled return to service (the planned date, not rolled forward).

gas_henry_hub.description: Henry Hub natural gas spot price (EIA).
notes: available_utc = 00:00 ET on the day after the trade date (backtest rule). EIA itself posts weekly; live use needs a same-day source.
EIA's NYMEX futures series (RNGC1-4) stopped on 2024-04-05, so there is no free gas forward curve; long-horizon energy norms need another source.

columns.trade_date: Gas trade date (spot for next-day flow). [date]
columns.price_usd_mmbtu: Henry Hub natural gas spot price. [$/MMBtu]
columns.available_utc: Earliest time this value could have been known (UTC). As-of joins must filter available_utc <= issue time. See conventions: as-of availability. [UTC timestamp]

weather_obs.description: Hourly weather observations at NY stations (NOAA GHCNh).
weather_obs.source: NOAA NCEI GHCNh by-year PSV; public domain
notes: Physically implausible values are dropped; GHCNh quality codes are not otherwise filtered.

columns.ts_utc: Observation hour (UTC); reports within ±30 min of the hour are averaged.
columns.station: Weather station code (config.WEATHER_STATIONS: BUF, ROC, SYR, MSS, ART, ALB, POU, HPN, LGA, JFK, ISP), each mapped to one or more NYISO zones.
columns.n_reports: Number of station reports averaged into the hour.
columns.available_utc: Earliest time this value could have been known (UTC). As-of joins must filter available_utc <= issue time. See conventions: as-of availability. [UTC timestamp]

weather_fcst.description: GFS 2 m temperature forecasts by lead time (forecast vintages).
weather_fcst.source: Open-Meteo previous-runs API, model pinned to gfs_seamless. RESEARCH USE ONLY (non-commercial licence)
notes: Only GFS temperature is archived back to 2021; other variables start 2024, so v1 uses temperature only to keep the feature consistent across the training history.
Upstream gap: no lead 1-7 forecasts for valid times 2023-12-30 .. 2024-01-19 (lead 0 only). As-of features are NULL there by design; models must handle missing temperature.

columns.ts_utc: Valid (forecast target) hour, UTC.
columns.station: Weather station code (config.WEATHER_STATIONS: BUF, ROC, SYR, MSS, ART, ALB, POU, HPN, LGA, JFK, ISP), each mapped to one or more NYISO zones.
columns.lead_days: Forecast made lead_days x 24 h before the valid hour (0 = latest run, ~analysis).
columns.available_utc: valid − lead_days × 24 h + 6 h model latency (conservative); lead 0: valid + 6 h.

weather_hrrr.description: NOAA HRRR 06z forecasts for the next delivery day, aggregated to NYISO zones.
weather_hrrr.grain: hourly x zone (one run per delivery day)
weather_hrrr.source: HRRR v4 via the University of Utah Zarr archive on AWS Open Data (s3://hrrrzarr); public domain
notes: Raw cache keeps only the cells inside NYISO zones (data/raw/hrrr/runs/YYYYMMDD.npz, float16).
Shortwave radiation is not included: the Zarr archive stores it for some runs only.
Zone polygons are approximate (county-based); external zones are not covered.

columns.ts_utc: Valid time of the (instantaneous) forecast, UTC; the delivery day's local hours.
columns.zone: NYISO internal zone (cells inside the approximate zone polygon).
columns.run_utc: Model run (initialization) time: 06:00 UTC on the day before delivery.
columns.wind80_ms: Zone-mean 80 m wind speed (m/s), hub-height proxy.
columns.cape_p90: 90th percentile over the zone's cells of surface CAPE (J/kg): convective instability.
columns.refl40_share: Share of the zone's cells with composite reflectivity >= 40 dBZ (heavy convection).
columns.lightning_density: Zone-mean forecast lightning flash density (HRRR LTNG, flashes km⁻² 5 min⁻¹).
columns.available_utc: run_utc + 2 h (the 06z run completes ~07:50 UTC); before the 05:00 ET issue.

columns.ts_local: Interval start in America/New_York wall-clock time (naive). Display only; ambiguous on the fall-back day — never join on it. [Eastern local time]
columns.covered_s: Seconds of the output bucket covered by data (300 = complete 5-min bucket, 3600 = complete hour). Weight for further time-weighted averaging. [seconds]
columns.net_load_mw: Load minus wind (GridStatus convention). NULL until fuel mix is posted.
columns.rt_lbmp: Simple average of the 11 internal zones' time-weighted RT LBMP ($/MWh). Not load-weighted; not a NYISO-published figure.

lbmp_zone_hourly.description: Hourly DA and RT LBMP by zone side by side, with DA−RT spread.
notes: Rows exist for tomorrow's DA hours with NULL RT.

columns.ts_utc: Interval START in UTC. The join key for every time series. See conventions: timestamps. [UTC timestamp]
columns.ts_local: Interval start in America/New_York wall-clock time (naive). Display only; ambiguous on the fall-back day — never join on it. [Eastern local time]
columns.zone: NYISO zone name as published by MIS: 11 internal load zones (WEST, GENESE, CENTRL, NORTH, MHK VL, CAPITL, HUD VL, MILLWD, DUNWOD, N.Y.C., LONGIL), 4 external proxy zones (H Q = Hydro-Québec, NPX = ISO-NE, O H = Ontario IESO, PJM), and 'NYISO'/'SYSTEM' totals where noted.
columns.rt_source: 'integrated' = NYISO's published hourly value; 'derived_twa' = time-weighted from 5-min intervals because NYISO's hourly file is missing (2026-07-01..20).
columns.rt_flag: NULL = OK. 'integrated_vs_5m_mismatch' = NYISO's integrated value differs from its own 5-min data by ≥ $0.02 (NYISO-side missing intervals or an hour in progress at download). Accepted; value kept as published.
columns.da_rt_spread: da_lbmp − rt_lbmp ($/MWh). Positive = DA priced above RT.

columns.ts_utc: Interval START in UTC. The join key for every time series. See conventions: timestamps. [UTC timestamp]
columns.fuel: NYISO fuel category: Dual Fuel, Natural Gas, Nuclear, Hydro, Wind, Other Renewables (includes grid-scale solar and biomass), Other Fossil Fuels.

load_hourly.description: Hourly time-weighted load by zone (incl. 'NYISO' total).

columns.ts_utc: Interval START in UTC. The join key for every time series. See conventions: timestamps. [UTC timestamp]
columns.zone: NYISO zone name as published by MIS: 11 internal load zones (WEST, GENESE, CENTRL, NORTH, MHK VL, CAPITL, HUD VL, MILLWD, DUNWOD, N.Y.C., LONGIL), 4 external proxy zones (H Q = Hydro-Québec, NPX = ISO-NE, O H = Ontario IESO, PJM), and 'NYISO'/'SYSTEM' totals where noted.

load_forecast_da.description: Day-ahead load forecast: the value issued the calendar day before the target local day.

columns.ts_utc: Interval START in UTC. The join key for every time series. See conventions: timestamps. [UTC timestamp]
columns.zone: NYISO zone name as published by MIS: 11 internal load zones (WEST, GENESE, CENTRL, NORTH, MHK VL, CAPITL, HUD VL, MILLWD, DUNWOD, N.Y.C., LONGIL), 4 external proxy zones (H Q = Hydro-Québec, NPX = ISO-NE, O H = Ontario IESO, PJM), and 'NYISO'/'SYSTEM' totals where noted.
columns.load_forecast_mw: NYISO load forecast (ISOLF) for the hour. [MW]

interface_flows_hourly.description: Hourly time-weighted interface flows and limits.

columns.ts_utc: Interval START in UTC. The join key for every time series. See conventions: timestamps. [UTC timestamp]
columns.interface: Interface name, e.g. 'CENTRAL EAST - VC', 'TOTAL EAST', or scheduled external lines 'SCH - PJ - NY'.
columns.flow_mw: Interface flow as published (MIS labels it MWH; it is a rate for the interval). [MW]
columns.pos_limit_mw: Positive-direction interface limit. ±9999 means no limit is enforced. [MW]
columns.neg_limit_mw: Negative-direction interface limit. ±9999 means no limit is enforced. [MW]
columns.covered_s: Seconds of the output bucket covered by data (300 = complete 5-min bucket, 3600 = complete hour). Weight for further time-weighted averaging. [seconds]

constraints_daily.description: Binding constraints summarized per local day.

columns.day: Calendar day in America/New_York (local day boundaries, so DST days have 23 or 25 hours). [date]
columns.facility: Limiting transmission facility (constraint) name as published.
columns.contingency: Contingency under which the facility binds ('BASE CASE' = no contingency).
columns.intervals: Number of binding intervals (hours for DA, RTD intervals for RT).
columns.hours_binding: DA: intervals. RT: intervals × 5/60 — assumes nominal 5-min intervals (approximation; RT constraint rows are not time-weighted).
columns.sum_cost: Sum of shadow_price over binding intervals ($/MWh summed; sign as published).

daily_summary.description: One row per local day: KPIs used by the dashboard and Trends.

columns.day: Calendar day in America/New_York (local day boundaries, so DST days have 23 or 25 hours). [date]
columns.avg_da_lbmp: Mean hourly DA LBMP over hours × 11 internal zones ($/MWh).
columns.avg_rt_lbmp: Mean hourly RT LBMP over hours × 11 internal zones ($/MWh); same basis as DA.
columns.main_source: Fuel with the highest average generation that day.
columns.avg_gen_mw: Time-weighted average total generation across fuel categories (MW).
columns.renewable_share: (Wind + Hydro + Other Renewables) / total generation (fraction 0–1). Excludes BTM solar.

fuel_mix_daily.description: Daily average generation by fuel, including BTM solar.

columns.day: Calendar day in America/New_York (local day boundaries, so DST days have 23 or 25 hours). [date]
columns.fuel: NYISO fuel category, plus 'BTM Solar' (from btm_solar SYSTEM).

lbmp_zone_daily.description: Daily average DA/RT LBMP and spread by zone.

columns.day: Calendar day in America/New_York (local day boundaries, so DST days have 23 or 25 hours). [date]
columns.zone: NYISO zone name as published by MIS: 11 internal load zones (WEST, GENESE, CENTRL, NORTH, MHK VL, CAPITL, HUD VL, MILLWD, DUNWOD, N.Y.C., LONGIL), 4 external proxy zones (H Q = Hydro-Québec, NPX = ISO-NE, O H = Ontario IESO, PJM), and 'NYISO'/'SYSTEM' totals where noted.

nodes.source: MIS generator/generator.csv (current list; retired units are absent)

columns.ptid: NYISO Point ID: numeric identifier of a pricing location (zone, generator node) or interface.
columns.name: Generator name (matches `node` in LBMP tables).
columns.zone: NYISO zone name as published by MIS: 11 internal load zones (WEST, GENESE, CENTRL, NORTH, MHK VL, CAPITL, HUD VL, MILLWD, DUNWOD, N.Y.C., LONGIL), 4 external proxy zones (H Q = Hydro-Québec, NPX = ISO-NE, O H = Ontario IESO, PJM), and 'NYISO'/'SYSTEM' totals where noted.
columns.subzone: Transmission-owner subzone, e.g. 'CON ED NY CITY'.
columns.lat: Latitude (WGS84) as published; NULL for ~270 generators.
columns.aggregation_ptid: PTID of the aggregation the unit prices under, if any.
columns.has_prices: True if the PTID appears in da_lbmp_node history.
